value.title: Builder warning-first guidance
value.summary: Builder uses the implementation guide as a map, not a permission system. Coders and PMs get actionable ownership warnings and a self-serve on-track view; work continues without declarations or acknowledgement ceremony. Import retains deterministic identity and evidence-integrity checks. This follow-on supersedes the ownership and two-receipt acknowledgement policies of plan 098 without rewriting their historical evidence.
value.complexity_breakdown: S2 + I2 + D2 + N1 + F1 + T1 = 9; three checkpoints, staged CLI-first rollout and retained evidence.
value.confidence: All eleven acceptance criteria have observed source/packed and native operational evidence after two tested corrections. Strict run compliance and full guided-skill conformance are not claimed. Increment 3 merge and global activation require separate authorization.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Builder uses the implementation guide as a map, not a permission system. Coders and PMs get actionable ownership warnings and a self-serve on-track view; work continues without declarations or acknowledgement ceremony. Import retains deterministic identity and evidence-integrity checks. This follow-on supersedes the ownership and two-receipt acknowledgement policies of plan 098 without rewriting their historical evidence.

sections.name: goals
value: Preserve clear ownership, readable scope and completion expectations while letting agents choose how to deliver the best result.
Let correct PM integration reach real checks immediately, even when edits cross mapped unit paths.
Make the same on-track warnings available before delivery, in receipts, and to the independent reviewer.
Replace two acknowledgement receipts and timing/nonces with one advisory self-check; keep actual import integrity enforced at the boundary that mutates the composition.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No amend verb, IntegrationAmendment record, justification form, permission prompt or enforcement opt-in for ownership deviations.
No blanket suppression of forged/mismatched evidence, wrong-tree imports, duplicate peers, rewritten history, operational failures or real product test failures.
No new agent runtime, model-attestation system, Flowspace ingestion, telemetry pipeline or forced fleet size.
No rewriting prior plan 098 receipts, retroactive claim that its historical runs passed, or import of the closed PR #200 implementation.

value.claim: The implementation guide retains units[].paths and read maps, and packets still carry the assigned unit, its job and observable done conditions; these maps guide work rather than granting write permission.

A committed PM change outside mapped PM paths produces file-by-file ownership warnings in the composition receipt and command result, then executes every configured composition check without amendment, justification or an ownership-caused nonzero exit.

Coder delivery and advancement/import report out-of-map history as the same warning list, including mapped owning unit(s) or an explicit unmapped result, and continue when actual integrity checks pass. No remaining ownership-only check in Builder may refuse.

A self-serve on-track command works in the coder clone and on the PM integration delta, including selected committed and current work as documented; it returns the same comparison and warnings with exit 0, performs no release/import/approval and does not change source.

The packet begins with plain-language ownership/read map, job and done conditions before mechanics. Its embedded unit remains available; first-use instructions lead directly to useful work rather than acknowledgement ceremony.

A coder can run one advisory self-check of expected clone, source commit and packet digest. Mismatch, drift or normal startup metadata yields named observations/warnings and repair advice rather than a work-release gate; there is no required second receipt, second nonce or clock window.

Dispatch, delivery, import, advance and review no longer depend on pre-work/post-release acknowledgement receipt IDs, phase nonces, canary challenge or plus/minus-five-second timing to authorize work; old records remain readable and need no replay or fabricated upgrade.

At import, wrong tree/commit lineage, forged or mismatched delivery/packet evidence, duplicate peer and rewritten baseline still refuse before an incorrect composition mutation. Each integrity refusal names the actual cause and corrective next step; legitimate descendant source and evidence-only commits retain their supported path.

Reviewers receive the recorded ownership warning list alongside the exact composed bytes; warnings do not veto review or advancement by themselves, and the PM cannot approve its own artifact as the independent reviewer.

The supported runtime, help, schemas, docs, skills and examples contain no amendment requirement or competing two-receipt startup path. PR #200 remains closed without merge; no alias or legacy gate revives its declaration design.

A real CLI/Git consumer scenario demonstrates map-first dispatch, one optional advisory self-check, cross-map coder/PM edits, warning-preserving import/composition, independent review and receipt-only archival re-observation; contrasting integrity failures still refuse and existing historical evidence remains unmodified.

value.title: Composition warnings unblock integration
value.brief: Ship the permanent composition-warning path first: correct PM integration reaches actual checks, with deviations recorded and visible to independent review. No declaration or consumer-specific bypass; preserve integrity refusals and prior evidence.

value.title: Map-first packets and advisory self-checks
value.brief: Replace the startup ceremony with work-first packets and one advisory self-check, removing release dependencies on the old acknowledgement sequence from every reader. Keep existing histories readable.

value.title: Warning-first delivery and end-to-end proof
value.brief: Complete shared on-track and delivery-warning semantics across all ownership checks; prove the actual CLI/Git consumer workflow, integrity contrasts, documentation/skill cutover and archive re-observation.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: The 2026-09-08 product ruling reverses ownership enforcement and the two-stage acknowledgement handshake. Existing Builder paths remain useful maps, but PM formatting and normal agent startup metadata exposed ownership checks as costly false blockers. PR #200 proposed candidate-bound amendment authority; it is closed and superseded, not a dependency. The code base already separates Git ancestry/digest checks from path ownership comparisons and provides stable JSON envelopes, unit records and composition receipts.

value.approach: Extend existing behavior/integrity suites, then use real CLI/Git source and packed smoke plus a live consumer receipt; selected proof rows stay unchecked until actually run.
value.rationale: Warning-vs-refusal is an observable contract. Faked Git deltas cannot establish real commit, archive or publication behavior. Plan validation proves this document only, never implementation.
value.focus_areas: Map parity; warning persistence/reader visibility; all ownership checks advisory; packet-first work guidance; one self-check; removal of handshake dependencies; unchanged import integrity and independent review; archive reads.
value.excluded: No new compliance quota or source-text pinning for its own sake; no live peer launch during planning.
value.mock_usage: Reuse injected repository fakes for branch cases; no vi.mock/spyOn. Retain real Git/process smoke for integration boundaries; promote regression tests only where a plausible failure is caught.

value.location: Update docs/how/harness-builder.md, source Builder/eng-harness-flow skills, packet templates/examples and CLI help in the same cutover; regenerate embedded docs/schemas through existing generators. Public wording is neutral; private ruling/evaluation pointers remain in scratch.
value.rationale: A new warning runtime with old acknowledgement or amendment instructions would recreate the same procedural blockage. Historical archived evidence stays historical, not rewritten policy.

sections.name: risks_assumptions
sections.value: CS-4: surface 2, integration 2, data/state 2, novelty 1, non-functional 1, testing/rollout 1 = 9. Assumptions: the product ruling is complete; no further ownership approval is required; existing reviewer independence and genuine product proof remain useful. Main risk is converting a mixed integrity/ownership check wholesale or leaving a downstream gate that silently reimposes the removed handshake. Stage rollout as three checkpoints with independently shippable composition guidance first. Keep old records readable without demanding missing new fields or replaying old acknowledgements. If a release fails, fix forward or revert only that release with retained evidence; never reset consumer source, falsify receipts or silently restore ownership policing.

value.question: Does an ownership warning require approval, justification, resolution or a special override to proceed?
value.answer: No. Agents and the PM decide; tooling records and explains the comparison, then continues.

value.question: Should the existing composition-only consumer blockage wait for the entire acknowledgement rework?
value.answer: No. Deliver composition warnings as the first permanent increment, with receipts and reviewer visibility, then the complete packet/self-check and delivery cutover. It is not a consumer-specific bypass.

value.question: What does planning authorize?
value.answer: Author this follow-on and send its path before any coder dispatch. No coder has been dispatched. Merge and machine-wide activation remain separately authorized operations.

value.question: How are older source and review results treated?
value.answer: Preserve original histories and schema snapshots. Superseded ownership refusals remain historical observations, not current policy. Do not require a new baseline or amendment just to apply warning semantics.

sections.name: implementation_summary
sections.value: Architecture and staged ownership are in assets/impl-guide.dd.json. The first increment is a single PM-owned composition transaction with independent review; phase-1 tasks are issued, later task detail remains for its checkpoint. No coder dispatch or fleet execution is claimed.

value.risk: An ownership-only condition remains hidden behind ready, delivery, review or acknowledgement and silently recreates the removed policy gate.
value.mitigation: Inventory all callers, compare warning lists across self-serve and automatic paths, and retain contrasting integrity tests.

value.risk: A broad error-code replacement weakens wrong-tree, mismatched-receipt or rewritten-baseline protection.
value.mitigation: Classify predicates by concrete effect rather than E477/E474 names; keep integrity checks at import before mutation.

value.risk: Plan-folder moves or evidence-only commits become false ownership drift during proof re-observation.
value.mitigation: Exercise original/current plan-folder metadata and real Git ancestry; preserve historical artifact bindings without amendment records.

value.risk: Runtime and deployed instructions describe different acknowledgement contracts.
value.mitigation: Stage CLI-first deployment and source-only skill refresh, with explicit phase boundaries and no stale alternate handshake in the completed cutover.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Use one warning computation and one warning shape across on-track, delivery, composition and reviewer evidence; no parallel policy engine.
Keep warnings separate from check results: ownership drift cannot be the cause of a nonzero exit, but a failed build/test must stay failed.
Historical receipts are read-only evidence. New producers stop emitting the old handshake; readers must not demand its nonce/timestamp/release sequence as an ownership gate.
Exact runtime/model/effort configuration is not provider-served identity attestation.
All evaluation evidence stays local with HARNESS_NO_TELEMETRY=1; no Flowspace, no private identifiers in tracked documents.
Do not dispatch coders until this plan path has been delivered to the prime; do not treat planning status as review, source-baseline or implementation proof.
